highlights.description: Local telemetry plane: one loopback daemon for OTLP ingest, a read-only query API over the OmniDevX event store, and provisioned Grafana dashboards
Durable live token/cost capture from Claude Code and Codex CLI, independent of local session-history retention
Stdlib-only OTLP/JSON support — no protobuf or gRPC dependencies; log payloads acknowledged and discarded, never stored

added.description: Daemon (cmd/omnidevx-otel): loopback OTLP/HTTP JSON endpoint composing omnidevx-core's genericotel receiver, with -addr/-person/-store flags

GET /api/series: on-demand time-bucketed aggregations (tokens, cost, activity, commits with AI share) over the canonical store, day or week buckets, since/until bounds, optional collection-mode filter
Grafana provisioning: Infinity datasource against the query API and a four-panel dashboard (tokens/day, cost/day, session activity, weekly AI-assisted commit share) using Grafana time-range macros

tests.description: Query API tests over a fixture store spanning an ISO week boundary: per-metric aggregation, message/usage token combination, mode filtering, Monday week bucketing, AI commit share, unknown-metric rejection, health

documentation.description: PRD, TRD, PLAN, and ROADMAP specs (docs/specs): the store stays canon, the daemon owns no data, loopback only
README with architecture diagram, Claude Code telemetry configuration, and Grafana setup

infrastructure.description: CI workflows (go-ci, go-lint, go-sast-codeql), golangci-lint config, dependabot, MIT license, gitignore
